plan.failureSummary: Deterministic cache replay failed to find the 'Last Name' input element because the live survey form is presenting alternative fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email').
observedIndicators: The failure stack trace points directly to deterministic replay inside `.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js`.
Cached replay attempted to locate `[data-testid='input-lastname']` / `Last Name *`, which is absent from the live DOM.
The live failure screenshot displays fields for 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' rather than separate first/last name fields.

The test's high-level page.ai instruction ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') has flexible semantic intent and can easily fulfill the survey under the updated layout when run autonomously.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for `tests/unstable-survey.test.ts` and retry the test so that the AI can dynamically inspect and fill the current survey form.

plan.notes: The target site is an unstable/dynamic survey that presents varying form layouts. Clearing the Page.AI cache and allowing an autonomous run will let the AI adapt to the live form inputs.
